data.name: Sooraj
data.gender_notes: Sooraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sooraj is derived from the Sanskrit word Surya, which means 'Sun'. In Hindu mythology, Sooraj is the name of the Sun God. This name signifies radiance, strength, and power, and is a reminder of the life-giving force of the sun. The name Sooraj carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sooraj usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sooraj is a sacred name in Hinduism, associated with the Sun God. It represents the divine energy and power of the Sun, and is believed to bring light, warmth, and strength to one's life.
data.etymology: Sooraj belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sooraj total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: Sooraj is the Sanskrit name for the Sun God. He is mentioned in the Rigveda, the oldest known Hindu scripture, which was composed between 1500-1200 BCE.

Another reference to Sooraj can be found in the Mahabharata, an epic Sanskrit poem that was likely composed between 400 BCE and 200 CE. Sooraj is described as the celestial king who rides his chariot across the sky each day.
